facts.fact: Senegal's Family, Social Action and Solidarity minister launched on 1 October 2026 payment of the bourses de securite familiale after two years' interruption, CFA140,000 per beneficiary household for 2026's four quarters, paid via mobile money operators (APS).

facts.fact: Senegal's government pays family security grants of CFA140,000 per household for 2026 through mobile money operators, so mobile money services are in operation (APS, 2026-10-01).
